review.notes: Fence balance scan, heading scan, whole-document word/4-gram diff of the OCR Markdown against extracted text of all 8 physical PDF pages, and a U+200B scan that found zero occurrences in this card's text layer. Rendered verification at 110-300 dpi covered physical p.2 (Table 1 first column and both table footnotes), p.3 (footnote 3), p.4 (Figure 1 heatmaps and Figure 2) and the embedded Figure 3 win-rate charts. Table 1 value/setting pairings (MATH, MGSM, DROP, GSM8K) were checked column-by-column against the print and are correct. The words missing on physical p.5 (STEM, Medicine, Honesty, Harmlessness, win-rate axis labels) are internal to the embedded Figure 3 image and were not patched.

patches.before: Table 1 This table shows evaluation results for reasoning, math, coding, reading comprehension, and question answering evaluations.
patches.after:
Table 1 This table shows evaluation results for reasoning, math, coding, reading comprehension, and question answering evaluations.

$^{1}$Results for Llama 3 400B are from the April 15, 2024 checkpoint [16]. All metrics are for the Instruct version of the model, other than DROP and BIG-Bench Hard, which are evaluated on the pretrained version of the model.
$^{2}$ OpenAI’s simple-evals suite [17] lists MMLU scores of 88.7% for gpt-4o and 86.5% for gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09. The simple-evals MMLU implementation uses 0-shot CoT.
patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.2 (300 dpi crop inspected) prints two footnotes below Table 1: '1 Results for Llama 3 400B are from the April 15, 2024 checkpoint [16]. All metrics are for the Instruct version of the model, other than DROP and BIG-Bench Hard, which are evaluated on the pretrained version of the model.' and '2 OpenAI's simple-evals suite [17] lists MMLU scores of 88.7% for gpt-4o and 86.5% for gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09. The simple-evals MMLU implementation uses 0-shot CoT.' The superscript markers 1 and 2 survive in the OCR table header ('Llama 3 400B^1', '0-shot CoT^2') but the footnote bodies were dropped; the patch reinserts them below the Table 1 caption with the document's $^{}$ superscript style.

patches.before: We saw large improvements in core capabilities like coding, documents, creative writing, and vision. Domain experts preferred Claude 3.5 Sonnet over Claude 3 Opus, with win rates as high as 82% in Law, 73% in Finance, and 73% in Philosophy.
patches.after:
We saw large improvements in core capabilities like coding, documents, creative writing, and vision. Domain experts preferred Claude 3.5 Sonnet over Claude 3 Opus, with win rates as high as 82% in Law, 73% in Finance, and 73% in Philosophy.

$^{3}$Section 5.5 of the main model card explains how win rates are calculated.
patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.3 (300 dpi crop inspected) prints the footnote '3 Section 5.5 of the main model card explains how win rates are calculated.'; the surviving marker $^{3}$ follows 'baseline of Claude 3 Opus.' in section 2.1 of the OCR but the footnote body was dropped. The patch reinserts it after the paragraph that carries the marker's section.

unresolved.evidence: For MATH, MGSM and GSM8K the print stacks value and shot-setting inside each cell while the OCR emits a values row followed by a settings row with filler cells; column-by-column comparison confirms all pairings are faithful, so only the glued first-column labels were patched.
